chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Jibraeel (peace be upon him): 'O Jibraeel! Which spots are the most beloved to Allah, Mighty and Majestic?' He said: 'The mosques, and the most beloved of their people to Allah are the first of them to enter and the last of them to exit from them.'

key_terms.آخِرُهُمْ خُرُوجاً: the last of them to exit
key_terms.أَوَّلُهُمْ دُخُولًا: the first of them to enter

ai.seo_question: Which places and people are most beloved to Allah according to the Prophet's dialogue with Jibraeel?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* through the chain of the Four Companions, this hadith establishes the mosque not merely as a physical structure but as the locus of divine proximity, emphasizing the virtue of *sabq* (hastening) to congregational prayers. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the spiritual merit of consistency and presence in the house of God, linking the physical act of worship with the spiritual status of the believer in the sight of Allah.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said to Jibraeel<sup>as</sup>: ‘O Jibraeel<sup>as</sup>! Which spot is the most Beloved to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic?’ He<sup>as</sup> said: ‘The Masjid, and the most Beloved of its people to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is the first of them to enter it and the last of them to exit from it’.
en.sarwar: 14. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jabir who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

The Messenger of Allah asked Jibril (Gabriel), “Which places are more beloved to Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious?” He replied, “It is Masjids and most beloved to Allah of its people are those who enter them first and leave last.’””
